description: a young woman druid with long auburn hair in braids and a crown of antlers, a mantle of green leaves over a green and brown robe with a wide belt, a gnarled wooden staff topped with a green crystal in her right hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
